products.title: Manors Gailes Windbreaker - Navy
products.body_html: The updated Gailes Windbreaker is made to tackle the gales of the world’s coastal courses with style and substance. Constructed from 4-way stretch, wind-repellent, and water-repellent fabric, it keeps you protected without sacrificing comfort or style. The relaxed fit, adjustable hem, and mesh lining ensure optimal performance and versatility, while its generous concealed pockets are perfect for stashing extra golf balls—you’ll need them where you’re going.

products.title: Manors Ranger Golf Jacket - Pine Green
products.body_html: These days, golfers are athletes, so why is our sport the only one without an iconic competitive tracksuit to warm up and play in? Not anymore. The Ranger Golf Jacket channels the bold vibe of ‘90s Olympic teams, Serie A squads, and NBA warm-ups, reimagined for the fairways. Made from crinkled nylon with 5% elastane, it blends vintage texture with stretchy, water-resistant performance for unrestricted swings. Raglan sleeves, contrast piping, and striking back branding add retro flair, while a ¼-zip design, breathable mesh lining, and concealed storage pockets deliver modern function. Perfect for warming up or playing through, this jacket keeps you moving and looking sharp.

products.title: Manors Merino Tech Hoodie - Dune
products.body_html: The Merino Tech Hoodie is built from 100% natural merino wool, the game's original performance fabric. It keeps you warm when the wind bites, cool when the sun breaks through, and it won't hold odour even after a long day on the course. Unlike the scratchy wool jumpers of the past, this one is soft, machine-washable, and won't shrink or lose shape. A three piece hood and laser cut woven chest pocket, inspired by shapes on the course, are finished with ribbed cuffs and hem for comfort. Smart enough for the clubhouse, tough enough to live in your bag.

products.title: Manors Tour Shirt - Powder
products.body_html: The Tour Shirt is a wind and water resistant short sleeve layer inspired by vintage wind proofs. It's ideal for layering over a polo or long sleeve when conditions shift. At 148gsm, the lightweight 4-way stretch fabric combines freedom of movement with protection against the elements. Curved front and back panelling with raglan sleeves provide a comfortable, relaxed fit, while concealed pockets keep essentials safe and dry. A bonded YKK centre front zip and adjustable hem with cord and toggle ensure versatility when the temperature swings as much as you do.

products.title: Garmin Approach Z10
products.body_html:
LEAVE THE GUESSWORK OUT OF YOUR GAME
Compact design. Complete game changer. Get confidence on the course with Approach Z10, the laser rangefinder for every golfer.

RANGE RELAY
Sync the ranged distance to the pin with your compatible smartwatch, handheld or the Garmin Golf™ smartphone app, plus see a laser range arc that reveals everything in play.

PLAYSLIKE DISTANCE
PlaysLike Distance lets you adjust yardage for uphill or downhill shots based on the change in elevation from where you’re standing.

PLAN YOUR APPROACH
See distance from the pin to the front and back of the green directly through the viewfinder to quickly understand where the pin is located on the green.

MAGNETIC CART MOUNT
A built-in magnetic cart mount makes for quick and convenient ranging when riding in a golf cart.

TOURNAMENT MODE
An external indicator light lets you and your playing partners know when your device is in tournament mode.

FIND MY GARMIN
When paired to the Garmin Golf smartphone app, you can use Find My Garmin to locate your range finder if it’s left behind.

The INOVAI 10.0 combines the best of blade and mallet in a sleek, compact head that offers a brand-new look to the INOVAI Series. While resembling a wide-body blade, the two-piece construction of 303 Stainless Steel and 6061 Military-Grade Aluminum was engineered to shift weight toward the rear and perimeter of the putter, to give it the high MOI that players seek in a mallet. The simple shape of the body creates ideal visual cues at address, and the smooth flange is detailed with double sightlines for ease of setup and alignment. The 10.0 is perfect for players seeking to transition from a blade putter to a high-performance MOI mallet or players looking for a mallet with a more compact profile.

 

HIGH MOI
The weighting across the entire 2024 INOVAI Series was optimized to have a high MOI (Moment of Inertia), meaning the putters are more resistant to twisting or turning and more forgiving on off-center strikes.

ROLL CONTROL™ FACE MILLING
Developed in conjunction with the top players in the world, Bettinardi’s proprietary Roll Control™ face milling promotes forward roll at impact to get the ball into a true roll faster while reducing skid or sidespin.

303 STAINLESS STEEL & 6061 ALUMINUM
The two-part design of each INOVAI putter consists of a 303 Stainless Steel face piece and a 6061 Military-Grade Aluminum back. This combination of premium metals balances each INOVAI model while the golfer experiences ultimate feel and control.

GLARE-RESISTANT FINISH
Featuring a new Midnight Armor finish on the face piece and a Titan Gray finish on the back, the 2024 INOVAI Series provides a glare-resistant view at address with white paint fill accents and triple sightlines.

The BB1 Wide was designed by RJB with a refined profile based on feedback from Tour players seeking a more forgiving putter with the classic blade-style headshape. RJB engineered the BB1 Wide with an improved center of gravity by taking more material from the heel while compressing the heel-to-toe length. This refinement also resulted in a more uniform headshape allowing for simple setup and alignment. The BB1 Wide stands out as our first production putter with a soundslot through the flange, which combined with our new Perpetual Flymill face results in superior audible feedback and masterful control on every putt.

 

CENTER OF GRAVITY SHIFT 
By reshaping the bumpers and shoulders, the Center of Gravity aligns more naturally at address. This enhanced COG establishes a more unified weight distribution, ensuring contact with the sweet spot to achieve a more crisp roll.

PERPETUAL FLYMILL FACE MILLING 
Redefining precision putting, our Bettinardi’s Perpetual Flymill Face Milling technology is now enhanced by sonic precision. This innovative technology provides a consistent roll, ensuring that your putts start true and on target. Each stroke produces a distinctive tone, providing instant feedback to the player.

BLACK PEARL PVD FINISH 
The deep, luxurious black hue of Black Pearl PVD not only exudes sophistication but also adds an extra layer of confidence upon address. Beyond its striking appearance, the PVD coating is highly resistant to wear, scratches, and corrosion.

303 STAINLESS STEEL

products.title: 1000 Tattoos
products.body_html:
Trawl through centuries of tattooing in this eye-popping history of the art of body decoration. From modest, discreet symbols to astonishing full-body adornments, the wonders of 1000 Tattoos will entertain, amaze, and inspire. Whether you’re considering getting ink done yourself or are simply curious about what lengths others have gone: this is the guide you’ve been looking for.
Hardcover, 5.5 x 7.7 in., 1.85 lb, 544 pages

products.title: TATTOO. 1730s-1970s. Henk Schiffmacher’s Private Collection
products.body_html:
Legendary tattoo artist and historian Henk Schiffmacher takes us on a personal journey through the history of tattooing from the 1730s to the 1970s in this oversized book of stunning tattoo artifacts and designs. Showcasing over two hundred years of worldwide tattoo history, the book brings together the best of Schiffmacher’s renowned private collection with lively personal commentary by the art’s most beloved raconteur and philosopher.
Hardcover, 11.4 x 15.3 in., 13.52 lb, 440 pages

products.title: Garmin Approach S70 Golf GPS Watch - White 42mm
products.body_html:
FEATURES

  • Stunning AMOLED display brings more than 43,000 preloaded full-color CourseView maps to life on your wrist
  • Look good on and off the course with a lightweight, stylish design and ceramic bezel
  • Enhanced golf course maps allow you to see intricate details with the ability to pan and zoom for narrowing in on your target distance
  • Improved virtual caddie feature shows your shot dispersion data and suggests a club based on a variety of factors, including your historical swing data, elevation, wind speed, wind direction and more
  • Enhanced PlaysLike Distance feature accounts for uphill shots, downhill shots and trajectory as well as wind, temperature and air pressure with a built-in barometer — for more accurate plays like distances
  • Plan the best approach shot, and sink the putt with green contour data — which shows you the green’s slope direction and severity on select courses (available with an active Garmin Golf™ app membership)
  • Easily keep score as you play, and upload to the Garmin Golf™ app for stat tracking and handicap calculation
  • AutoShot round analyzer measures and auto-records detected shot distances and pairs with optional Approach® CT10 club tracking sensors for more automatic game-tracking capabilities, including detecting putts and chips
  • Improve your strength and mobility with preloaded activity profiles for strength, yoga, cardio and more so you can hit the ball farther and prevent injuries
  • Get a more complete picture of your health with wrist-based heart rate, stress tracking, Body Battery™ energy monitoring, advanced sleep monitoring and more so you can perform your best on the course (data presented is intended to be a close estimation of metrics tracked)
  • Pay for your food at the turn with Garmin Pay™ contactless payments (with a supported payment card); listen on the go when you download songs and playlists from Spotify, Amazon Music or Deezer (subscription may be required)

products.title: Sneaker Freaker Issue 46
products.body_html:
The highlight of Issue 46 is a trio of killer collector features. Simply B brings the heat from Miami, while Brooklyn-born Chris Rosario flexes hard with his stash of big-game ballers from the late 90s. Finding a quality BAPE STA collector has been on my to-do list for some time, but the OGs seem to have tapped-out years ago. No doubt about it, Nigo’s fruit-flavoured Air Force 1 knock-offs owned the streets of New York and Tokyo in the early 2000s and took the hype game right up to Nike. 

The BAPE STA bootleg battle segues perfectly into the legal dramas that have engulfed the scene this year as Nike looks to assert some control over John Geiger, Warren Lotas, KickRich and others. Who knows where this daily soap opera will end up, but our 7000-word historical analysis should offer plenty of context as we delve deep into an issue that balances trademark protection with the endless creativity that customisers bring to the game. There’s way, way more of course, but you’ll have to buy a copy to find out.

The Greyson Racquet Aspen Hoodie is constructed from a pima cotton blend to deliver superior comfort from the court to the couch. Designed with a series of signature racquet logos, this elevated sweatshirt features a double-layer hood and ribbed cuffs and hem for added comfort.

100% Cotton

products.title: Greyson Cokato Hoodie - Scareb
products.body_html:
Constructed from a technical blend of nylon and elastane, the Cokato Hoodie is the epitome of functional luxury. The brushback knit fabric is breathable, lightweight, and delivers a soft feel. Decorated with a perforated camo interior neck, blind seams, and an elongated utility pocket on the front right side of the garment. The hood is built as a funnel neck for warmth and style. Finished with the iconic reflective wolf on the left cuff.

45% Polymide | 40% Cotton | 15% Elastane

Pockets Fabric: 100% Polyester

products.title: Greyson Yukon Hybrid Jacket - Shepherd
products.body_html:
For an exceptionally lightweight layer, the Yukon Hybrid Jacket was engineered to protect you from the elements. Constructed from a technical nylon blend for plenty of stretch and mobility, this versatile staple features a matte layer shell and channel-quilted front with a full zipper. Designed with two zippered front pockets and prima loft gold standard fill, this jacket can be easily layered.

Primaloft® Insulation | Superior Warmth & Softness | Windproof | 4-way stretch | Quick Dry Shell

Quilted Body Fabric: 90% Nylon | 10% Spandex Back and Sleeve Fabric: 45% Polyester | 40% Cotton | 15% Elastane Filling: 100% Polyester

products.title: Redvanly Monroe Polo - Rio
products.body_html:
PRODUCT

The Monroe Polo defines confidence. Offering both placket and collar accent, this style will have you both noticed, and admired. Spread self collar and 3 button placket front closure.

 Model is 6'1 and wearing size medium

TECHNOLOGY

PUREpoly is the softest and stretchiest polyester/spandex blend you will wear. We took over two years to develop this blend and take the typical poly/span to the next level. Aside from the insane stretch and softness, this fabric will keep you dry and light on those super hot days.

products.title: Redvanly Hicks Hoodie - Stone
products.body_html:
PRODUCT

Distressed in design, determined in results; the Hicks hoodie has your back in fashion and functionality. Made from our signature STRETCHknit fabric that offers a super soft, 4-way stretch, two-yarn moisture-wicking and easy care. Finished with front pouch and elasticized cuffs.

Model is 6’1 and wearing size medium

    TECHNOLOGY

    STRETCHknit is a combination of a weighted polyester(77%) and spandex (23%) along with a brushed interior for ultimate softness. This fabric blend was specifically made to keep you warm while still allowing you to be mobile while performing.
